title: Domashi
source: Bodoland Tourism culture page (tourism.bodoland.gov.in); Boro culture (Wikipedia)
content:
Bodoland Tourism Domashi ko Bodo logon ke teen mukhya tyohaaron mein ginata hai
(Kherai, Domashi aur Bwisagu). Wikipedia mein bhi ise Bodo tyohaaron ki suchi
mein rakha gaya hai. Is tyohaar kab aur kaise manaya jaata hai, iska vivran abhi
kisi verified source se nahi liya gaya; kisi Bodo bolne wale se confirm karna baaki hai.
